caso.texto:
Process Studio offers analysis of four workflows and a report three weeks after inputs arrive, excluding implementation. The buyer adds training and integration without changing price or timing. Acceptance criteria and input ownership are missing. Sales promised an immediate start.

A US professional-services buyer requests an SOW with named deliverables, acceptance review and change control. Its IT contractor must approve integration, which is not included. USD pricing and tax treatment need explicit confirmation.

projeto.instrucoes: Produce a diagnosis, scoped proposal and delivery plan; assess the additional request as a change affecting time, responsibility and price.
projeto.gabarito: Keep four-workflow analysis and report as the baseline, starting after inputs. Define ownership and acceptance. Training and integration require separate review and approval, not automatic error correction. Correct the unsupported immediate-start promise.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
